title: Import a menu JSON into the shadow build (Heartland has no CSV path)
summary: Heartland menu edits are Admin Console fields and terminal state - there is no owner-facing CSV. This workflow takes canonical or heartland-flat JSON into staging, audits it, and stops at the portal-side entry with the field checklist.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: canonical JSON or the legacy flat array from the heartland-pos tooling (fixtures resolve as a fallback)

steps.title: Confirm what the source file actually is
steps.instructions: A bare JSON array of {name, category, price, modifiers, time_ranges} is the legacy flat export the audit scripts consume: no pricing-rule stack, no channels, no group limits. Never treat it as a backup - take the canonical export for that.

steps.title: Stage the file into the workbench (normalization runs on import)
Audit the staged menu before it can be approved
Client approves the scope before any portal entry starts
steps.instructions: Walk the findings and the diff summary. Modifier isolation changes ordering UX, so it needs explicit sign-off - audit before action.

steps.title: Enter the fields in the Admin Console; read back the terminal state
steps.instructions: Admin Console > Menu > Items and > Modifiers for names, prices, Assigned Items, Min/Max Choices, Number of Included Ingredients, per-ingredient Default Price and Available Online. Stock limits and 86 state live on the terminal (long-press the item, or Manager > Item Stock Management) and never appear in a portal export.
